description: iOS in-app symbol style: monochrome SF Symbols-style glyphs for tab bars, toolbars, buttons, and list rows. Distinct from launcher app icons.

prompt_blocks.house_style: iOS in-app symbol style: a clean monochrome SF Symbols-style UI glyph, drawn as a simple filled or stroked silhouette that can be used as a template image and tinted by the app. Centered optical balance, rounded stroke joins, high legibility at 24x24, no enclosing launcher tile, no coloured background, no scenery, no text.
prompt_blocks.purpose_wrapper: a transparent UI glyph for "{purpose}" - render this as a monochrome SF Symbols-style in-app symbol, not as an app launcher tile

forbidden_artifacts: Do not produce app launcher icons, Home Screen tiles, rounded-square backgrounds, badges, app-store artwork, or full-colour brand illustrations.
Do not include text, labels, captions, watermarks, signatures, UI chrome, screenshots, or multiple panels.
Do not draw complex scenes, photorealistic objects, heavy gradients, soft drop shadows, or glossy 3D effects.
Do not use the chroma-key colour or chroma-adjacent colours in the glyph.
